approved_scope: Proceed with the documented 52-compound high-quality serial calculation workflow.
Use the standardized, explicitly labelled modelling assumptions for unresolved structure, pD, explicit-solvent cluster and reference conventions.
Use D2O as the primary model for F3_019, F3_020, F3_021, F3_035, F3_043 and F3_044; use DMSO-d6 for the remaining primary models unless separately documented.
Run one ORCA job at a time under the recorded resource guardrails.

approved_standardized_states.F3_019: L-asparagine zwitterion; D2O; nominal pD 7.4; 6/8/10 explicit-water convergence branches
approved_standardized_states.F3_020: L-glutamine zwitterion; D2O; nominal pD 7.4; 6/8/10 explicit-water convergence branches
approved_standardized_states.F3_021: L-argininamide dication with two solvent-separated chloride ions; D2O; nominal pD 5.5; 8/10/12 explicit-water convergence branches
approved_standardized_states.F3_035: sulfamate anion; D2O; nominal pD 7.0; 4/6/8 explicit-water convergence branches
approved_standardized_states.F3_043: neutral phosphoramide; D2O; nominal near-neutral pD; 4/6/8 explicit-water convergence branches
approved_standardized_states.F3_044: monoanion diamidophosphate; D2O; nominal pD 7.0; 4/6/8 explicit-water convergence branches; no invented experimental counterion assignment

not_preapproved: Future numerical ORCA results or their scientific validity.
Result-dependent GOAT ensemble selections, minimum/frequency audits or Boltzmann weights.
Reference-job output hashes that did not yet exist at the time of approval.
Any claim that a calculated or synthetic spectrum is experimentally acquired.
